name: cavemio-steps-form
title: Steps form
description: A multi-step form in one card that changes shape: steps slide in from the way you’re going, checks shake and explain, and Create turns into what comes next.

cavemio.accessibility:
- It’s a form: Enter in a field continues, the title labels it, and errors are announced with role="alert".
- Focus moves to each new step’s first field (or an element marked data-autofocus), but not on first load.
- Steps that aren’t showing are unmounted, so keep their values in your own state, as the demo does.
- Installs Number roll, Status button and Text morph. With reduced motion steps swap in place, nothing shakes, and the card resizes instantly.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: steps
props.type: { id, label, title, description?, content, validate? }[]
props.description: – · In order. You own the fields’ state; content is whatever the step shows.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: – · Runs after the last step’s check. Throw to stay on the last step; the error’s message is shown.

props.name: submitLabels
props.description: "Create", "Creating", "Created" · The last button’s labels as it runs.

props.name: done
props.description: – · What the card turns into once it’s submitted.

props.name: onStepChange
props.description: – · Runs when the step changes, e.g. for analytics.

features.title: One card, many steps
features.description: The next step slides in from the way you’re heading while the card eases to its new height. Going back slides the other way.

features.title: Progress people can see
features.description: A bar of segments fills, the step’s title morphs and “2 / 4” rolls.

features.title: Checks before moving on
features.description: validate() can be async. A problem shakes the step and the reason folds open under it.

features.title: Back only when there is a back
features.description: The Back button folds away on the first step, so Continue never jumps.

features.title: Submit shows its work
features.description: On the last step Continue becomes your action, spins, draws a check, and the card turns into whatever comes next.

features.title: Keyboard and focus
features.description: Enter continues, focus moves to the new step’s first field, and errors are announced.

states.title: header
states.description: Segments fill left to right as scaleX (520ms); the label and title morph; the counter rolls.

states.title: step
states.description: The new step slides 28px in from the direction you’re going out of a 4px blur (420ms) while the old one slides out the other way (260ms); the card’s height eases (440ms). Focus moves to the new step’s first field.

states.title: check
states.description: validate returns a message: the step shakes (±6px, 380ms) and the message folds open under it with an alert icon. A promise shows the button’s spinner and "Checking" until it settles.

states.title: back
states.description: Hidden on the first step by folding its column to nothing (360ms), so Continue never jumps.

states.title: submit
states.description: On the last step the button reads your label; onSubmit runs with Status button’s spinner, then a drawn check, and 750ms later the header and footer fold away and done replaces the step. A thrown error shows its message and "Try again".
